_about: Stairs and ladders between the level 0 floor and the catwalk decks over it. Direct, like every level link: no fade, no halt (landing offset and prefetch distance come from stairs_links.json). Read by world/route/catwalk_links.rs, not by the region catalogue. chance is the share of chunks with a deck that get links; per_chunk caps them; spacing is the fewest cells between two links in a chunk; ladder_share is the share of links that are ladders (the rest are stairs); ladder_rise is the tallest deck (m) a ladder serves, a taller deck always takes stairs.
